scope: Real Vita full host, original sample01_sw PFS, original saves2/3 copied to temporary names, no asset overrides or format changes. Each run 10s warmup and >=35s sampling, fixed12 timed circle presses; matched model sequences. Timed input is not frame-synchronized dialogue replay; source-read cold startup is excluded. One before/after pair per slot with four measured model-create events per run.
changes: Skip pixel/palette memcmp only when pointers already identify identical bytes and lengths/formats/dimensions/host checks match. Distinct allocations retain full exact comparisons, including fingerprint collisions.
Retain immutable PSB backing for pending BC3 uploads, eliminating the intermediate 8MiB source allocation/copy. Default callers without a backing lease and CI8 conversion retain owned-copy behavior.

SourceLifetime keeps both CpuModel and Rust source/budget lease alive until view teardown plus final pending texture upload/cancellation. Adopt only on successful creation. No GPU fence, retirement, shader, mesh, effects, animation or cache quota change.
timing_scope: Switch frames are first logged spikes following model-create entries, including other logic/effects. Suppressed spikes are not reconstructed. Upload diagnostics emit only >20ms. Mean FPS describes dialogue advancement, not a stationary scene. Model creation includes contexts/view binding, excludes subsequent GPU upload.
